title: Twisted associative algebras and intertwining operators
summary: For a vertex algebra $V$ with a finite-order automorphism $g$ satisfying $g^T = 1$ for some $T \in \mathbb{N}$, we construct an associative algebra $\tilde{\mathbf{A}}^{g,\infty}(V)$ and prove that the category of $\frac{1}{T}\mathbb{N}$-graded $g$-twisted $φ$-coordinated $V$-modules is isomorphic to the category of graded $\tilde{\mathbf{A}}^{g,\infty}(V)$-modules.
